help.stdout:
usage: gnd extract [-h] --out OUT [--guidelines] model

Derive the per-model extraction artifacts OFFLINE from model.orm.yaml:
<stem>.projection.schema.json (the closed, shape-only structured-output
projection, gated by a recursive allowlist that fails closed on unlisted
keywords), <stem>.verbalization.txt (the constraint-blind rendering seed),
<stem>.applicable.json (the three-path reference-scheme applicable set) and
<stem>.artifacts.json (sha256 digests plus the header_template the executing
skill copies verbatim), plus <stem>.guidelines.md with --guidelines. No
provider is called and no network is touched — the executing agent running the
gnd-extract skill is the only place a model is ever called. Exits 0 when the
bundle is emitted, 3 when the model is invalid, 64 on usage errors, 70 when
the projection gate refuses gnd's own emitter (an internal invariant breach),
74 when the output path is refused or unwritable.

positional arguments:
  model         path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --out OUT     output directory for the bundle (four files, five with
                --guidelines)
  --guidelines  also write <stem>.guidelines.md, constraint-blind per-fact-
                type guidance (readings, role players, descriptions, reference
                modes), digest-recorded in <stem>.artifacts.json
